rows.evidence: Underlying IoD25/ONS/Police.uk generator exists and is readable.
Canonical 92,283-feature point source exists with the expected blob.
Wrapper changes the inclusive parcel range to parcel_30762 through parcel_31061.
Wrapper output JSON, web JSON and HTML paths match the queued task exact_write_paths.
Wrapper uses 12 row workers; source generator uses 10 official-source probes. Task maximum remains 12 simultaneous workers.
rows.detail: Do not raise above 12 without a new hardware manifest.

rows.evidence: Police.uk documents an average limit of 15 requests per second, burst 30, with HTTP 429 after the limit is exceeded.
rows.detail: Use a Police-domain limiter with safety margin and honour Retry-After when present.

rows.evidence: verify_base calls police_query independently for every row; no cache or per-request-key future is present.
rows.detail: Known identical request parcel_30801/parcel_30802 produced one HTTP 200 and one HTTP 429.

rows.evidence: The fetch helper retries three times with fixed short sleeps but has no global token bucket, jitter or Retry-After handling.
rows.detail: Recommended: exact-query cache plus <=10 Police requests/second and exponential jitter.

rows.evidence: iod_join_rows counts joined candidate rows, while the gate compares it with len(target_lsoa_codes), which counts unique LSOA codes.
rows.detail: A fully joined dataset with repeated LSOAs can be reported PARTIAL. Compare joined eligible rows with eligible rows instead.
